Groww.summary: Groww offers stocks, mutual funds and ETFs, plus UPI payments through Groww Pay.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Above 18 and legally able to enter contracts. Link and confirm a bank account; mobile-network and SMS verification may apply.

requirements.label: Online demat account
requirements.text: PAN, email, personal details and a linked bank account. Complete Aadhaar KYC using an OTP sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number.

notes: UPI age terms date from May 2023; eligibility at exactly 18 is unclear.
Whether Groww Pay needs a demat account is unclear.

Money View.summary: Moneyview offers personal loans through lending partners and UPI payments.

requirements.label: Personal loan
requirements.text: Ages 21–57; salaried or self-employed; monthly household income of at least ₹25,000 paid into a bank account. CIBIL 650+; lender approval required.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: A savings account, SMS permission and the SIM for your Moneyview-registered mobile number. Select that SIM and your bank during setup.

requirements.label: RuPay credit card on UPI
requirements.text: An active RuPay credit card from a supported bank is needed for this optional payment method.

notes: UPI minimum age is not confirmed.
The complete loan-document checklist is not confirmed.

INDmoney.summary: INDmoney offers stocks, mutual funds, finance tracking, bill payments and UPI.

requirements.label: App account
requirements.text: 18+. An authorised guardian can register for a minor and may need to provide proof of authority.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: An active INDmoney account, a bank account linked to your mobile number, and device/SMS verification. You must be legally able to enter contracts and meet HDFC Bank's UPI conditions.

requirements.label: Online demat account
requirements.text: Personal details, PAN/Aadhaar KYC, bank/address proof and a signed account-opening document. Minors cannot open and operate the account independently.

notes: UPI access for guardian-managed minor accounts is not confirmed.
US stocks, loans and other products have separate eligibility rules.

Digikhata.summary: Pay Point's Digi Khata offers a prepaid account, UPI payments and a RuPay card in India.

requirements.label: Prepaid account
requirements.text: Indian resident, with PAN, Aadhaar, OTP and video verification. No existing bank account or credit check is required; add money before spending.

requirements.label: Prepaid account age
requirements.text: The account terms require 18+; the FAQ says above 18.

requirements.label: Offline verification
requirements.text: Kiosk help is available. If Aadhaar is not linked to your mobile number, an offline verification route is available.

requirements.label: Kiosk or merchant partner
requirements.text: Physical KYC is required for Digi Kiosk and Digi Vyapaar partners. Kiosk checks include identity, address and shop/establishment documents.

notes: Eligibility at exactly 18 is unclear.
Whether every individual must visit a kiosk is unclear.

Aditya Birla Capital Digital.summary: ABCD offers UPI, bill payments, loans, investments and insurance.

requirements.label: App account
requirements.text: 18+, Indian resident and legally able to enter contracts. Registration uses profile details and links your device and SIM; additional checks depend on the service.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: An active ABCD account and your own Indian bank account linked to an active mobile number. Be in India when registering or linking the bank; mobile-network and SMS verification may apply.

requirements.label: UPI age
requirements.text: Payment terms require users to be above 18 or have a parent's or guardian's permission and supervision.

requirements.label: Loan
requirements.text: Allow credit-report checks and complete the lender's KYC and e-NACH requirements. Missing KYC or e-NACH can lead to rejection.

notes: General registration and payment age rules differ; access for minors is not confirmed.
Loan income and CIBIL cutoffs are not confirmed.

Shriram One.summary: Shriram One offers UPI, bill payments, deposits, insurance and loans.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Complete app signup, then select your bank, bank-linked SIM and bank account. Allow the verification SMS and keep enough SMS balance; RuPay-card linking is optional.

requirements.label: Personal loan
requirements.text: Indian resident; at least 21 when applying and no older than 60 when the loan ends. Income stability and credit history are assessed.

requirements.label: Personal loan employment
requirements.text: The application form is for salaried applicants. Self-employed customers may qualify with a pre-approved existing relationship; others may be directed to business loans.

requirements.label: Personal loan documents
requirements.text: Identity/address proof, recent photos, three months of income proof, six months of bank statements and a cancelled cheque/mandate form.

notes: UPI minimum age is not confirmed.
Personal-loan income and CIBIL cutoffs are not confirmed.
Deposits, insurance and other loans have separate eligibility rules.

Jar.summary: Jar offers digital-gold purchases, recurring gold savings and UPI payments.

requirements.label: Digital-gold account
requirements.text: Above 18 and legally able to enter contracts; a parent or guardian may consent to a child's registration. Sign up with personal details and a mobile OTP.

requirements.label: Daily gold saving
requirements.text: Starts at ₹10.

requirements.label: Digital-gold tax status
requirements.text: Declare that you are not GST-registered and report any later change.

requirements.label: Digital-gold verification
requirements.text: Government ID/PAN verification may be required, with Form 60 accepted where allowed; pay from your own bank account. Physical delivery requires KYC.

notes: UPI joining requirements are not confirmed.
The signup process for a minor's gold account is not confirmed.
The app listing and website terms name different gold providers; check the provider in-app before buying.

Tata Pay.summary: Tata Pay offers UPI and bill payments through Tata Neu.

requirements.label: Tata Pay account
requirements.text: 18+, Indian resident and legally able to enter contracts. Register for Tata Neu membership with accurate profile and contact details.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Sign in to Tata Neu and link your own account, which you must be authorised to operate. Use the same mobile number for both accounts, then complete outgoing-SMS and device/mobile-network verification.

Obopay.summary: Obopay offers prepaid wallets with UPI and card features that vary by programme.

requirements.label: Wallet
requirements.text: Indian resident and legally able to enter contracts, with an internet-connected device, email and your registered mobile number.

requirements.label: Wallet age and nationality
requirements.text: The FAQ requires Indian nationals above 18; current terms require Indian residence but give no numerical age.

requirements.label: Wallet payments
requirements.text: Full KYC is required to transact: verify Aadhaar through DigiLocker, then complete video identification. Add money to the wallet before spending.

requirements.label: UPI and cards
requirements.text: Access to UPI, a card or both depends on your corporate programme.

notes: Joining without a corporate sponsor is not confirmed.
UPI bank-linking steps are not confirmed.

Curie Money.summary: Curie Money combines liquid mutual fund investing with UPI payments.

requirements.label: Mutual funds
requirements.text: 18+, an Indian citizen and Indian tax resident, and legally able to enter contracts. KYC verification is required, with fund-house documents, including PAN where required, for first-time investors.

requirements.label: Investment-funded UPI
requirements.text: Hold mutual-fund units and link the holder's bank account registered with the fund house. Signup uses PAN and bank details; Curie Save redeems units into that bank account to fund payments.

notes: Standalone bank-funded UPI requirements, including age and whether investing is mandatory, are not confirmed.
UPI SIM and device requirements are not confirmed.

LXME.summary: Lxme is a finance app marketed to women, with mutual funds, learning tools and UPI.

requirements.label: App account
requirements.text: Indian citizen and Indian tax resident; above 18 or with legal parental or guardian consent.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Register, allow SMS access and link a bank account associated with your mobile number. Set up a UPI ID and UPI PIN.

requirements.label: RuPay credit card on UPI
requirements.text: Link an eligible RuPay credit card to use this optional payment method.

requirements.label: Investments
requirements.text: Complete KYC, verify your details and meet the investment-readiness checks. Use your own bank account for investment payments.

notes: The signup process for minors is not confirmed.
Investment minimums, loan requirements and fixed-deposit-backed card requirements are not confirmed.

Unimoni.summary: Unimoni offers a prepaid wallet for bill payments and transfers, with UPI top-ups.

requirements.label: Wallet
requirements.text: 18+, legally able to enter contracts, and a mobile number verified by OTP. Minimum-KYC and full-KYC wallet options are available.

requirements.label: Full KYC and transfers
requirements.text: Transfers require full KYC. Wallet terms require PAN, accepted identity/address documents and submission at a branch; the FAQ also offers app and agent routes.

notes: Wallet terms now use Wizzpay and Wizzmoni names; the exact app-version match is unclear.
PAN requirements differ between the FAQ and current terms.
Wallet-issued UPI handle setup is not confirmed.

Novio.summary: Novio offers UPI payments and RuPay credit cards backed by fixed deposits.

requirements.label: App account
requirements.text: 18+ and legally able to enter contracts. Create a profile in the app.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Indian resident, with an active account at a participating bank that you are authorised to operate, linked to your mobile number. Use a compatible internet-connected device; network/SMS verification may apply.

requirements.label: DCB novio FD-backed credit card
requirements.text: Virtual card: fixed deposit starting at ₹2,000. Physical card: ₹10,000 fixed deposit.

notes: Full card eligibility rules for DCB, SBM, IOB and YES BANK are not confirmed.

LivQuik.summary: LivQuik's QuikWallet app offers prepaid wallets, cards and UPI payments.

requirements.label: Primary prepaid account
requirements.text: 18+, Indian citizen and resident, legally able to enter contracts, and tax-resident only in India.

requirements.label: Prepaid account identity checks
requirements.text: Provide personal, contact and identity details. You must not fall within the politically exposed person category excluded by the account terms.

requirements.label: Minors' prepaid access
requirements.text: Minors can use services through a parent or legal guardian registered on the platform.

requirements.label: Small and full-KYC wallets
requirements.text: Small wallets have limited features; full KYC requires documents and verification. Verification may use video, biometrics or Aadhaar OTP where enabled.

notes: QuikWallet's UPI KYC tier and setup steps are not confirmed.
Partner programmes and dependent cards have separate conditions.
